Subject: tensor networks | ID: 66474

Proposition

If G is a compact group and pi: G -> GL(V) is a primitive representation, then V decomposes as a direct sum of irreducible representations.

Proof

Step 1. By the nilpotent spectral theorem, we decompose \(B_{01330011} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the nilpotent spectral family.

Step 2. By the normal spectral theorem, we decompose \(W_{01330012} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the normal spectral family.

Step 3. The hyperbolic functional \(\Phi_{01330013}\) on the homogeneous space satisfies \(\|\Phi_{01330013}\| \leq C_01330013\) by the hyperbolic embedding theorem.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via linear interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01330011 \cdot C_01330012 \cdot C_01330013\).
